title: LLM-as-Judge Semantic Evaluation Result
description: Schema for opt-in semantic-equivalence judgments that run alongside deterministic exact-match scoring. Version 0.1.0 — contract/protocol only; no judge execution until authorization gates are met.

model_id.description: Model identifier used for semantic judging (e.g. claude-sonnet-5).

model_version.description: Exact model version string for reproducibility.

corpus_version.description: Version of the benchmark corpus judged against.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the judge run completed.

authorized_by.description: Who authorized this judge run (user identifier or 'offline-fixture').

authorized_question_count.description: Number of questions authorized for judging.

estimated_cost_usd.description: Estimated cost in USD before execution.

calibration_set_path.description: Path to the human-labeled calibration set used for acceptance validation.

authorization.description: Authorization fields required before any judge execution.

human_labeled_count.description: Number of questions with human-labeled ground truth in the calibration set.

judge_agreed_count.description: Number of calibration questions where judge agreed with human label.

agreement_rate.description: judge_agreed_count / human_labeled_count. Null if human_labeled_count is 0.

semantic_match_count.description: Questions where judge found semantic equivalence.

semantic_mismatch_count.description: Questions where judge found no semantic equivalence.

abstention_count.description: Questions where judge abstained from classification.

disagreement_count.description: Questions where semantic and deterministic scores disagree.

semantic_match.description: Whether the response is semantically equivalent to the expected answer. Null when abstained.

confidence.description: Judge confidence in the classification (0-1). Null when abstained.

rationale.description: Judge's reasoning for the classification or abstention. Required for all judgments.

abstained.description: True if the judge could not classify this question (insufficient context, ambiguous, etc.).

deterministic_match.description: Whether the deterministic exact-match scorer found a match for this question.

disagreement.description: True when semantic_match and deterministic_match differ.

human_label.description: Human-labeled ground truth for calibration questions. Null if not in calibration set.
